title: The Finance Guy Lied About A Fee. I Had It On Tape.
script: The finance manager told me the eight hundred dollar dealer prep fee was non-negotiable and required by the manufacturer, so I said fine, but I forgot to mention I'd been recording the whole negotiation on my phone since we started, which is legal in my state. Two days later I called to cancel the sale after finding the exact same fee waived for a friend at the same dealership that same week. The manager on the phone insisted the fee was mandatory for every customer, no exceptions, so I drove back in and asked to speak to the general manager directly. I played eleven seconds of audio, his own finance guy, on the record, calling the fee basically just extra profit, don't worry about it. The general manager's face changed instantly. He refunded the full eight hundred dollars on the spot, comped an oil change package, and the finance manager was gone from the floor within a week.
